primary_sources.title: Landesman, Vakil and Wood, Corrigendum (online22 April2026)
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete publisher main text: arithmetic Gorensteinness is required for arbitrary embeddings; the four-point collinear counterexample; canonical embedding existence is distinguished from unrestricted uniqueness. The present note proves the required property directly.

primary_sources.title: Stacks Project, quasi-finite Gorenstein morphisms
primary_sources.used_statement: Finite relative duality Hom_A(B,A), and invertibility criterion for Gorenstein covers; the elementary Frobenius and quadratic proofs are given in the new note.

primary_sources.title: Stacks Project, dualizing modules for quasi-finite ring maps
primary_sources.used_statement: Equation49.2.0.1 and Lemma49.2.5 with complete proof: the finite relative dual is Hom_A(B,A), compatible with flat base change. Finite local freeness also makes Hom commute with residue-field base change by the elementary dual-basis calculation.

primary_sources.title: Wood, Parametrizing quartic algebras over an arbitrary base (2011)
primary_sources.used_statement: Retained PF57 complete PDF7-8 visual inspection, Section3 oriented quartic/cubic discriminant identity. No new appeal to an unrestricted projective-embedding uniqueness theorem.
